method: 144 fixed normalized sample points within visible side plane; nearest render sampling; bounded six-parameter affine projection; one global RGB slope+offset; diffuse only, no shadow material and no pixel-specific recoloring

domain.orientations: 4 quarter turns x optional horizontal reflection

limitations: Only visible inner portion; rear hood fold and shoulder-occluded bottom deliberately excluded.
A nonzero residual supports correspondence only; not exact original UV proof.
The tested rectangle sizes are bounded; untested sizes or piecewise surfaces could fit differently.
Lighting is a single channel-wise affine fit per face, not the original material.
No model or UV was modified.
Best ox and vy approach the chosen projection bounds; crop endpoints are sensitive to the assumed plane bounds, so this study does not establish a unique exact UV rectangle.
interpretation: Best-ranked windows cluster around x19..30/y8..20 and fit the sampled visible-side pattern better than the current x10..20 region. The best projection touches bounds, so exact rectangle endpoints are not uniquely established. No acceptance of full original equivalence.
